correctness.rationale: The trajectory-count lower bound is complete for every even n>=4: for some initial state there are at least n-1 advancing defect letters; each intervening gap has >=n-1 rotations and hence >=m-1 additional defect letters under a^3 avoidance. The explicit all-n word has exactly that many letters, no triple rotation, and the image-set induction E_r/O_r ends at {0}. The independent exact BFS checks n=4,6,...,16 and constructive block checks n=4,6,...,100 all returned VERIFY_OK. Neither finite test is used as the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: The canonical Cerny family is used to test synchronization latency. Restricting at most two consecutive rotations is a natural finite-control/duty-cycle requirement. An all-even-state sharp closed formula and explicitly exhibited family show an asymptotic 3/2 loss, quantifying a nontrivial resource-vs-latency penalty. This is not a mere small-n census or a change of alphabet names. The parity-based attaining construction is mathematically substantive.
